haemodynamics.cardiac_output_source: 本项目心脏模型实算（四腔时变弹性腔 + Windkessel，60.5 s 静息窗）
haemodynamics.map_source: 同上，本项目心脏模型实算
haemodynamics.fraction_source: The splanchnic bed receives about 25 % of cardiac output at rest and the superior mesenteric artery about 10 %, roughly doubling to tripling after a meal (Barrett KE et al., Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology 26th ed., ch. 32; Doppler series give fasting SMA flow 0.3-0.6 L/min and postprandial 1.0-1.6 L/min) —— 教科书量级，非本项目实测
haemodynamics.smv_flow_note: 静脉回流取动脉流量的 92%（其余为淋巴回流与肠腔净吸收水分），教科书量级近似
haemodynamics.smv_trunk_radius_derivation: Murray's law at the portal confluence: r_SMV = r_portal * (Q_SMV/Q_portal)^(1/3)

portal_coupling.measured_on: 本项目肝脏页在同一受试者 s0236 的 portal_vein_and_splenic_vein 标签上实测
portal_coupling.note: 肠系膜上静脉 → 门静脉是本项目肠-肝跨器官耦合点；SMV 口径由该实测门静脉半径经 Murray 定律导出，不是另造的数

haemodynamics.lymph_flow_note: 静息肠淋巴 1-2 mL/min，脂肪吸收时可增至约 10 倍；教科书量级，非本项目实测

respiration.source: 由本项目心率模型拟合的呼吸性窦性心律不齐频率导出（PhysioNet nsrdb/16265 公开数据）

waveform_source: 本项目心脏模型第 11 个心动周期的 Q_aortic，按该周期均值归一；肠系膜动脉粒子速度用它调制搏动性

slow_wave_frequency_per_min.gradient: linear in arc length between the two published end values

motility.slow_wave_source: Interstitial cells of Cajal set the slow-wave frequency; it falls aborally from ~11-12/min in the duodenum to ~8-9/min in the ileum (Code CF & Marlett JA, J Physiol 1975, doi:10.1113/jphysiol.1975.sp011034; Hansen MB, Pharmacol Toxicol 2003, doi:10.1034/j.1600-0773.2003.920101.x)
motility.wave_speed_source: Peristaltic contractions travel aborally at 2-4 cm/s in the small intestine (Barrett KE et al., Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology 26th ed., ch. 25)
motility.wave_implementation: a travelling radial constriction c(s,t) = A*exp(-((s - v t) / w)^2) is applied to the parametric lumen radius at arc length s, so the ring really moves along the three-dimensional wall; the mesh is NOT scaled as a whole
motility.wave_depth_note: 收缩深度 45% 为可视化取值，未从影像测得，已声明为参数化
motility.segmentation_vs_propulsion: segmentation = standing contractions at the local slow-wave frequency (mixing); peristalsis = the propagating ring (transport). Both are rendered; the frequency gradient belongs to the former.
motility.mmc_phase_III_note: 移行性复合运动 III 相（清扫波）未建模

layers.name: mucosa
layers.contents: epithelium (enterocytes, goblet, Paneth, enteroendocrine, tuft, stem) + lamina propria + muscularis mucosae

layers.name: submucosa
layers.contents: dense connective tissue, submucosal (Meissner) plexus, arteriolar/venular plexus, lymphatics

layers.name: muscularis_propria_circular
layers.contents: inner circular smooth muscle; the layer that generates the peristaltic ring

layers.name: myenteric_plexus
layers.contents: Auerbach plexus between the two muscle layers, with the interstitial cells of Cajal pacemaker network

layers.name: muscularis_propria_longitudinal
layers.contents: outer longitudinal smooth muscle; shortens the segment ahead of the wave

wall.source: Normal small-bowel wall is <=3 mm thick when distended; the four layers are mucosa (epithelium + lamina propria + muscularis mucosae), submucosa (Meissner plexus), muscularis propria (inner circular + outer longitudinal with the Auerbach plexus between) and serosa (Macari M & Balthazar EJ, AJR 2001, doi:10.2214/ajr.176.5.1761105)
wall.note: 层厚取已发表范围的中点量级，不是在本受试者 CT 上测的 —— 1.5 mm 体素无法分辨这些层

micro.amplification_source: Classical three-level amplification of the small-intestinal absorptive surface: circular folds (plicae circulares / Kerckring) x3, villi x10, microvillus brush border x20, about x600 in total (Wilson TH, Intestinal Absorption, 1962; reproduced in standard physiology texts). Helander HF & Fandriks L (Scand J Gastroenterol 2014, doi:10.3109/00365521.2014.898326) revise the resulting absolute mucosal area downward to ~30 m2 while keeping the same amplification structure; both are reported.
micro.smooth_cylinder_area_note: computed from THIS model's measured centreline arc length and its parametric calibre: pi * d(s) ds
micro.amplified_area_discrepancy_note: the classical x600 applied to this geometry gives a larger area than the ~30 m2 that Helander & Fandriks (2014) arrive at by direct morphometry; the computed value is reported as computed and the published revision is shown next to it, neither is adjusted to match the other
micro.dimension_source: Villus height 0.5-1.6 mm, crypt depth 0.1-0.4 mm, enterocyte height ~25 um, microvillus length ~1 um (Standring S, Gray's Anatomy 42nd ed., ch. 64)
micro.turnover_source: Human small-intestinal epithelium renews in about 3-5 days, stem cells at the crypt base migrating to the villus tip (Darwich AS et al., Curr Drug Metab 2014, doi:10.2174/1389200215666140918114755)
villus_contents: one arteriole ascending the villus core and venules descending beside it, the counter-current exchanger
micro.countercurrent_note: 绒毛内小动脉与小静脉逆流交换为公认解剖，本可视化按已发表结构绘制，未做氧分压或溶质梯度的定量求解
micro.magnification_note: 各视图的放大倍数在界面上逐级标注；绒毛-隐窝单元与刷状缘按真实尺寸建模后再放大显示

acat_absorption.source: Compartmental absorption and transit: the small intestine is represented as 7 well-mixed compartments in series, mean total small-intestinal transit time 199 min (Yu LX & Amidon GL, Int J Pharm 1999, doi:10.1016/S0378-5173(99)00147-7; Yu LX et al., Int J Pharm 1996, doi:10.1016/0378-5173(96)04640-0)

midazolam.ka_derivation: ka = ((1-Fa)^(-1/N) - 1)/tau, closed form from the published Fa for an N-compartment first-order absorption chain; no fitting
midazolam.mechanism: high permeability, complete absorption; both the enterocyte and the hepatocyte extract it through CYP3A4, so the gut wall is a first-pass organ in its own right
midazolam.citation: Midazolam is the CYP3A4 probe with a double first pass: intestinal availability F_g ~0.51 and hepatic availability F_h ~0.56, oral bioavailability ~0.30 (Thummel KE et al., Clin Pharmacol Ther 1996, doi:10.1016/S0009-9236(96)90177-0; Paine MF et al., Clin Pharmacol Ther 1996, doi:10.1016/S0009-9236(96)90176-9)

fexofenadine.ka_derivation: ka = ((1-Fa)^(-1/N) - 1)/tau, closed form from the published Fa for an N-compartment first-order absorption chain; no fitting
fexofenadine.mechanism: negligible metabolism; absorption is limited by P-gp pumping drug that has entered the enterocyte straight back into the lumen, and by OATP-dependent uptake
fexofenadine.citation: Fexofenadine is essentially not metabolised; its low oral bioavailability (~0.33) is an absorption-limited phenotype set by P-gp efflux and OATP uptake (Cvetkovic M et al., Drug Metab Dispos 1999; Lippert C et al., Pharmacotherapy 1995)

chain: apical uptake into the enterocyte (passive + OATP2B1/PEPT1)
enterocyte: CYP3A4 oxidation and P-gp efflux back to the lumen
basolateral exit to the villus capillary network
superior mesenteric vein -> portal vein -> liver (second pass)
acat_absorption.no_calibration: 本项目没有任何把表达量换算成 Jmax 或 CL_int 的标定系数，也不发明一个。表达谱只做定性映射（哪些细胞类型、沿轴哪一段表达高），吸收与首过用的是已发表的 Fa/Fg/Fh 与转运时间，二者在界面上分开标注。

CYP3A4.source: Intestinal CYP3A4 is highest in the duodenum/proximal jejunum and falls aborally; the small intestine is the second largest CYP3A4 pool after the liver (Paine MF et al., Drug Metab Dispos 2006, doi:10.1124/dmd.105.008672)

ABCB1_Pgp.source: P-glycoprotein (ABCB1) expression increases from proximal to distal small intestine, the mirror image of CYP3A4 (Mouly S & Paine MF, Pharm Res 2003, doi:10.1023/A:1025032511040)

SLC15A1_PEPT1.source: Intestinal CYP3A4 is highest in the duodenum/proximal jejunum and falls aborally; the small intestine is the second largest CYP3A4 pool after the liver (Paine MF et al., Drug Metab Dispos 2006, doi:10.1124/dmd.105.008672)

SLC10A2_ASBT.source: The apical sodium-dependent bile acid transporter ASBT (SLC10A2) is confined to the terminal ileum (Dawson PA et al., J Lipid Res 2009, doi:10.1194/jlr.R900012-JLR200)

axial_adme_gradients.why_not: the single-cell reference used for the molecular layer is resolved by CELL TYPE, not by position along the gut axis; the axial direction of each gradient is therefore carried from the cited literature and labelled as such, never computed from the expression table
